dictionary.annotation-destination: Data is pushed to a destination completing a flow
dictionary.annotation-modelize: Data is validated, standardized and optionally warehoused
dictionary.annotation-source:
Sources pull data to a given destination
(They have a single output)
dictionary.annotation-finance-payment: Payment data from multiple providers is collected and standardized
dictionary.annotation-finance-warehouse: Standardized payment data is stored for consolidated reporting
dictionary.annotation-portfolio-cloud: Insurance data from multiple cloud providers is consolidated
dictionary.annotation-portfolio-unified: Unified insurance data view across all providers
dictionary.annotation-external-inbound: Receive and process data from third-party systems
dictionary.annotation-external-outbound: Send processed results back to third-party systems
dictionary.annotation-aggregator-docs: Documents from cloud storage are collected for processing
dictionary.annotation-aggregator-ai: AI processes and analyzes the aggregated documents
dictionary.annotation-crm-hubspot-sync: Data from HubSpot is synchronized with Salesforce
dictionary.annotation-crm-transform: HubSpot data is transformed to match Salesforce schema
dictionary.annotation-crm-warehouse: Salesforce data is warehoused for historical reporting
dictionary.modal-config-description: This is your current Data Layer configuration based on the connected flows. This configuration can be directly used during deployment of your Data Layer instance.
dictionary.modal-connection-data-time-range-descrip: Show data from the last X days
dictionary.modal-connection-description: This tool will automatically visualize your Data Layer flows based on the Audit DB records. Keep in mind this is purely a visualization tool and does not affect your Data Layer in any way. Logs and other sensitive information are not stored or sent anywhere.
dictionary.modal-connection-inactive-threshold-desc: Mark flows as inactive after X days
dictionary.modal-import-description: Paste in a configuration to import. The format should match the export format.
dictionary.service-imported-message: Since this service was inferred from an active Audit DB connection and not from an existing Data Layer configuration, we can't show its run parameters.
dictionary.tutorial-service: Build your own use-case with various services
